title: Merge from Debian unstable (LP: #2163660)
description:
Merge os-prober 1.85 from Debian unstable into stonking.

Remaining changes (unchanged delta):
 - Ignore logger socket-errors (LP #1826294)
 - Replace newns by unshare --mount from util-linux
 - Mount btrfs subvolume @ when present
 - Return list of Windows partitions for WINOSDATA
 - Fix 50mounted-tests for grub-probe recognition

Debian 1.85 only adds an LC_ALL=C fix for the EFI grep; no overlap with our delta.

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~levihackerman-102/+archive/ubuntu/os-prober-merge

diff --git a/Makefile b/Makefile
deleted file mode 100644
index 1175bba..0000000
--- a/Makefile
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,9 +0,0 @@
-CFLAGS := -Os -g -Wall
-
-all: newns
-
-newns: newns.c
-	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(LDFLAGS) $^ -o $@
-
-clean:
-	rm -f newns
diff --git a/common.sh b/common.sh
index 1e19b5b..9bc3858 100644
--- a/common.sh
+++ b/common.sh
@@ -1,5 +1,15 @@
 newns () {
-  [ "$OS_PROBER_NEWNS" ] || exec /usr/lib/os-prober/newns "$0" "$@"
+  if [ "$OS_PROBER_NEWNS" ]; then
+      return
+  fi
+  export OS_PROBER_NEWNS=1
+  # This is best-effort; if for some reason, unshare --mount is not available,
+  # don't worry about it.
+  if /usr/bin/unshare --mount -- /bin/true; then
+      exec /usr/bin/unshare --mount -- "$0" "$@"
+  else
+      exec "$0" "$@"
+  fi
 }
 
 cleanup_tmpdir=false
@@ -59,7 +69,7 @@ cache_progname() {
 
 log() {
   cache_progname
-  logger -t "$progname" "$@"
+  logger --socket-errors=off -t "$progname" "$@"
 }

+Recommends: util-linux (>> 2.37.2)
 Description: utility to detect other OSes on a set of drives
  This package detects other OSes available on a system and outputs the
  results in a generic machine-readable format.

diff --git a/linux-boot-probes/common/50mounted-tests b/linux-boot-probes/common/50mounted-tests
index ad68874..e57f51e 100755
--- a/linux-boot-probes/common/50mounted-tests
+++ b/linux-boot-probes/common/50mounted-tests
@@ -52,8 +52,28 @@ if type grub-mount >/dev/null 2>&1 && \
    type grub-probe >/dev/null 2>&1 && \
    grub-mount "$partition" "$tmpmnt" 2>/dev/null; then
 	mounted=1
-	type="$(grub-probe -d "$partition" -t fs)"
-	[ "$type" ] || type=fuseblk
+	# don't break script if grub-probe doesn't recognize a filesystem (LP: #1987679)
+	type="$(grub-probe -d "$partition" -t fs || echo bad)"
+	if [ "$type" = bad ]; then
+		debug "mounted using GRUB, but bad filesystem?"
+		type=fuseblk
+	else
+		[ "$type" ] || type=fuseblk
+		debug "mounted using GRUB $type filesystem driver"
+	fi
+
+	case "$type" in
+	    btrfs)
+			if [ -x "$tmpmnt/@/lib" ] && \
+			   ! mount --bind "$tmpmnt/@" "$tmpmnt"; then
+				warn "failed to mount btrfs subvolume @ on $partition"
+				if ! umount $tmpmnt; then
+					warn "failed to umount $tmpmnt"
+				fi
+				mounted=
+			fi
+			;;
+	esac
 fi
 
 if [ "$mounted" ]; then

diff --git a/os-probes/mounted/x86/20microsoft b/os-probes/mounted/x86/20microsoft

--- a/os-probes/mounted/x86/20microsoft

@@ -14,7 +14,7 @@ dotify() {
 }
 
 # This script looks for legacy BIOS bootloaders only. Skip if running UEFI
-if [ -d /sys/firmware/efi ] && [ ! -f /var/lib/partman/ignore_uefi ]; then
+if [ -d /sys/firmware/efi ] && [ ! -f /var/lib/partman/ignore_uefi ] && [ -z "$WINOSDATA" ]; then
 	debug "Skipping legacy bootloaders on UEFI system"
 	exit 1
 fi
@@ -105,6 +105,34 @@ if [ -z "$found" ] && item_in_dir -q windows "$2" &&
 	found=true
 fi
 
+
+# Restrict to partitions containing the OS
+if [ -n "$WINOSDATA" ]; then
+    found=
+    if grep -aqs '^ *MaxVersionTested="10\.0\.[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]\.[0-9]" />' $2/Windows/SystemApps/Microsoft.Windows.FileExplorer_*/AppxManifest.xml; then
+        # FIXME: This could as well be Windows 11 (LP: #1987386)
+        long=${long:-"Windows 10 (data)"}
+        short=${short:-"Windows"}
+        found=true
+    elif [ -d "$2/ProgramData/Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/StartUp" ]; then
+        long=${long:-"Windows 8 (data)"}
+        short=${short:-"Windows"}
+        found=true
+    elif [ -d "$2/ProgramData/Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup" ]; then
+        long=${long:-"Windows 7 (data)"}
+        short=${short:-"Windows"}
+        found=true
+    elif [ -d "$2/Documents and Settings/All Users/Start Menu/Programs/Startup" ]; then
+        long=${long:-"Windows XP/Vista (data)"}
+        short=${short:-"Windows"}
+        found=true
+    elif [ -d "$2/Winnt/Profiles/All Users/Start Menu/Programs/Startup" ]; then
+        long=${long:-"Windows NT (data)"}
+        short=${short:-"Windows"}
+        found=true
+    fi
+fi
+
 if [ -z "$found" ]; then
 	exit 1
 fi
